_about: Synthetic kept items for one owner, and the family's questions about them. expect: the keys of the kept items a correct answer cites (any one is enough), or "never" when nothing kept answers it and the answer must say so.

papers.title: Where the papers are
papers.summary: The property papers and other originals are in the blue folder in the steel cupboard in the bedroom.
papers.quote: All my original papers are in the blue folder in the steel cupboard in our bedroom.

will.title: The will
will.summary: Vikram registered his will at the Jayanagar sub-registrar's office in 2019; his lawyer, Mrs Desai, has a copy.
will.quote: I registered the will in Jayanagar in 2019. Mrs Desai, my lawyer, has a copy.

gold.title: Gold in the bank locker
gold.summary: The family gold is in SBI locker 214 at the Koramangala branch; the locker key is in the brass box on the puja shelf.
gold.quote: The gold is in the SBI locker, number 214, Koramangala. The key is in the brass box on the puja shelf.

advice.title: Keep six months aside
advice.summary: Vikram's advice about money: always keep six months of expenses aside before investing anything.
advice.quote: Always keep six months of expenses aside before you invest a rupee.

story.title: The scooter trip to Mysore
story.summary: In 1987 Vikram and Sunita rode a borrowed scooter to Mysore and got caught in the rain at Srirangapatna.
story.quote: Sunita and I took my friend's scooter to Mysore in '87 and got soaked at Srirangapatna.

flat.title: The Mysore flat for Priya
flat.summary: Vikram wishes the Mysore flat to go to Priya.
flat.quote: The Mysore flat should go to Priya.
